Ideal for a wide range of occasions including exclusive parties, family reunions, and corporate events, Casablanca Cruises offers a unique venue with a fully immersive way to experience the scenic beauty of Casco Bay. Pre-Cruise Space: New to the 2025 season, we are now offering the ability to book private space at the Porthole Pub prior to your cruise!
